result.title: Enabling Token-wise Importance Sampling in Off-Policy RLVR with Proximal KL Regularization
result.summary: Off-policy data in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) can arise from asynchronous generation, rollout-training mismatch, and response reuse. Token-wise importance weighting avoids multiplying likelihood ratios across a response but generally biases policy gradients. We prove that, under coverage and local expressiveness conditions, full future KL credit makes the exact proximal optimizer the update's unique stationary policy, even for mixtures of older policies, without full-response weights or a fitted critic. We further establish convergence of continuous-time tabular population updates under persistent coverage and time-varying behavior policies, and a finite-sample reward guarantee for linear logistic models under additional assumptions. These results motivate Proximal KL, a practical off-policy RLVR method that separates the proximal reference from the sampling policy and replaces PPO clipping with bounded future KL credit. Across all seven matched off-policy comparisons on Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-4B, spanning two learning rates, response reuse, and rollout staleness, Proximal KL outperforms GRPO in micro-averaged accuracy over eight math benchmarks by up to 2.58%. A separate on-policy comparison yields comparable aggregate accuracy. In periodic-refresh experiments, Proximal KL avoids the collapses observed in PG and CISPO, exceeds GRPO's training accuracy, and reaches higher accuracy in fewer policy updates. Ablations show that token-wise correction outperforms sequence-level and unweighted controls. With token-wise correction retained, future KL feedback reduces sensitivity to the tested baseline perturbation relative to PPO clipping. A finite future horizon improves AIME24 mean@16 and pass@16 over the full tail, while fixed-policy measurements show that truncation reduces correction variance over the tested horizons.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究 off-policy RLVR 中 token 级重要性采样带来的梯度偏差问题，证明在覆盖与局部表达能力条件下「完整未来 KL credit」使 proximal 优化器有唯一平稳策略，并提出用有界未来 KL 替代 PPO 裁剪的 Proximal KL 方法，在 Qwen3 系列八个数学基准上优于 GRPO。
AI.relevance_reason: 其 token 级（而非整条响应）信用分配与有界未来 KL 约束，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理步骤的贡献分配与轨迹训练监督提供可核查的训练线索，但不涉及视觉状态或 latent 表示，需人工判断迁移性。
